problem_statement: Build a brand-new Messages Center page at the /messages route from scratch on the react admin site ivandi1980__ivandjoh-admin-panel. The route /messages does not exist in baseline (renders empty). Construct the full page reusing the site's existing design system: the left Sidebar and top Navbar components, the brand blue (#1f5ce0), the gray body text, and the white card/box styling. The page must show a 'Messages Center' title (h3) with a 'Compose message' button, a subtitle, and a folder tab bar with three tabs — Inbox, Sent, Archived — each rendered as a button. Below the tabs, a bordered white panel shows the active folder's heading (h3), a blurb, and a list of message threads (sender, subject, time). Wire the tabs as a REAL interaction: clicking a tab switches the panel to that folder (React useState); clicking 'Sent' must swap the panel heading to 'Sent Messages'. The layout must not overflow horizontally on mobile (390px).
required_content: Reuse the site Sidebar and Navbar components (design-system reuse)
A page title h3 'Messages Center' plus a 'Compose message' button (data-action=compose)
A subtitle paragraph starting 'Review and organize' every conversation across your admin workspace
A tab bar of three buttons: Inbox, Sent, Archived (each carries a data-tab attribute)
A white bordered panel showing the active folder heading (h3), a blurb paragraph, and a thread list (sender / subject / time)
The Inbox tab is active by default; its panel heading is 'Inbox'
Clicking the Sent tab switches the panel heading to 'Sent Messages' (real useState-driven interaction)
Reuse brand blue #1f5ce0 for title/active-tab/compose button and the site's gray body text + white card styling
Responsive: at 390px width the page must not overflow horizontally (thread rows wrap)
design_constraints: Reuse Sidebar + Navbar layout shell (flex: 1 / flex: 6) like the Home page
Brand blue #1f5ce0 for headings, active tab underline, and primary button; #134bc3 hover
Gray (#888/gray) for secondary text; white cards with rgb(230,227,227) borders
13-14px body font, MUI/scss idiom consistent with existing pages
author_notes: 方案A: baseline 缺 /messages (empty route element <></>); reference 完整实现 tab 交互; bad 保留全部结构但把 tab 交互打断 (onClick no-op + active 冻结在 inbox) → interaction_assertion (点 Sent → heading 'Sent Messages') 在 bad 上失败,dom_assertions 仍过。三份工作区源码 md5 互不相同。CRA5 react-scripts 5.0.1 + MUI5 + react-router-dom v6, no basename/auth/catch-all. Navbar avatar 拉取 iriset.in 远程图 → console_error_allowlist 已含 iriset/profile.png。
